verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition apart. The teal circle sits empty at the far left with the headphones pushed off it to the right. The $349 floats alone at the top and the logo is wedged beside the Pre-order button. The subcopy is stranded in tiny text at the far right, so the reading order is scattered and the hierarchy is weak. B reads clearly left to right with a bold headline and a prominent CTA, but it has clear flaws. The giant $349 competes with the headline. The logo has been moved into the circle that used to back the headphones, which now float on dark with no circle behind them. The subcopy is jammed against the top-right edge, and the Pre-order button nearly touches the right edge.
